title: Shunya Siddhanta & Quantum Architecture

chapters.nameEn: P-Adic Ultrametric Space & Nilpotent Time Reversal ([T]⁷ ≡ 0)
chapters.overview: Interpretive chapter. The snippet computes the 7-adic norm |x|₇ and labels a step count modulo 7 (“nilpotent_step”); the reading of this as time-reversal into a “ground void” is an interpretation, not a result.

slokas.deva:
पञ्चभूतात्मकं विश्वं नवधा सम्प्रकल्प्यते ।
शून्यत्वे सर्वभावानां पुनरावृत्तिरीक्ष्यते ॥
slokas.translit:
pañcabhūtātmakaṃ viśvaṃ navadhā samprakalpyate |
śūnyatve sarvabhāvānāṃ punarāvṛttirīkṣyate ||

anvaya.en: In the ultimate Śūnya ground state of all existence
Cyclic return and time-reversal is observed

slokas.translation: The universe composed of five elements is reckoned in nine states. In the Śūnya void, all manifest states collapse and return back to the origin.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation. Annex verse: not presented as a classical text.

chapters.nameSa: होमोमोर्फिक पेडरसन प्रतिबद्धता एवं ONP कोष-सुरक्षा
chapters.nameEn: Toy Pedersen-style Commitment & a 40/60 Split (not zero-knowledge)
chapters.overview: Interpretive chapter. A toy Pedersen-style commitment (exponents reduced mod 1000, modulus 2³¹ − 1) — not a zero-knowledge proof — and a function that splits an amount 40/60 with a 48-hour label. Not financial advice.

slokas.deva:
गुप्तं धनं सुसंरक्ष्यं द्विचत्वारिंशतात्मना ।
शून्याधिकारयोगेन सर्वं कर्म न रिच्यते ॥
slokas.translit:
guptaṃ dhanaṃ susaṃrakṣyaṃ dvicatvāriṃśatātmanā |
śūnyādhikārayogena sarvaṃ karma na ricyate ||

anvaya.en: Secret wealth must be cryptographically protected
Through the execution of Śūnya authority

slokas.translation: Cryptographic wealth must be sealed and protected. Through Śūnya balance protocols, no computational or economic effort is dissipated.
slokas.source: स्रोत अपरीक्षित · source unverified — no text in this repository carries this verse; it is not presented as a located quotation. Annex verse: not presented as a classical text.

slokas.deva:
अष्टोत्तरशतैरंशैः शून्यबिन्दुः प्रदृश्यते ।
कामाख्या-केदार-कन्या-त्रिकोणे मण्डलं विभु ॥
slokas.translit:
aṣṭottaraśatairaṃśaiḥ śūnyabinduḥ pradṛśyate |
kāmākhyā-kedāra-kanyā-trikoṇe maṇḍalaṃ vibhu ||

anvaya.en: The central Śūnya Bindu is revealed
The sacred geodetic triangle holds cosmic holonomy

slokas.translation: Across 108 degrees of quantum freedom, the Śūnya Bindu shines forth. The triangle of Kamakhya, Kedarnath, and Kanyakumari bounds universal holonomy.
